mission: Epoch AI is a research institute that tracks the key trends shaping AI (compute, data, chips, data centres, money and capabilities) and publishes open datasets, benchmarks such as FrontierMath and the Epoch Capabilities Index, and forecasts to inform governance.

key_work.title: Compute Trends Across Three Eras of Machine Learning
key_work.plain_summary: Showed training compute for frontier AI has grown far faster since 2010 than before, now about 5x per year for frontier language models according to Epoch's trend page.

key_work.title: FrontierMath: A Benchmark for Evaluating Advanced Mathematical Reasoning
key_work.plain_summary: Hundreds of new, very hard maths problems written by mathematicians to measure real reasoning without data leakage.

key_work.title: Can AI scaling continue through 2030?
key_work.plain_summary: Looks at power, chips, data and latency limits and concludes large scale-ups are feasible this decade.

key_work.title: Will we run out of data? Limits of LLM scaling based on human-generated data
key_work.plain_summary: Estimates when AI training will use up the stock of public human text.

key_work.title: Trends in AI (data hub)
key_work.plain_summary: Live headline numbers, such as compute stock of AI chips growing about 3.4x per year and the largest data centre at about 1.1 million H100-equivalents (site, Nov 2026).

warnings.text: AI inputs (compute, chips, data centres) are growing at extraordinary rates, so capabilities may keep advancing quickly.
Benchmarks saturate quickly and are struggling to keep up with AI capabilities.

recommendations.text: Ground AI policy in measured trends and open data.
Build harder, contamination-free benchmarks to track real capability.
